name: Booking State Model
description: Feature-layer state shared by results, passengers, seat map, summary and CTA bar: one client state object for selections, and a server-owned quote for every price.

provenance.tag: Rec (D16, D17). Cash+Miles and four cabins: Official; trip types and lap infants: A · unverified.

rules: One client state object for selections. Every component reads from it; none owns the data. Components dispatch actions; only the state layer writes.
The server owns every price (D16). The client never calculates a fare, seat fee, tax or total. It sends selections to the server and displays the quote that comes back.
Fares belong to a journey; seats belong to a segment (one physical flight) (D17). Seats are keyed by segment, never by journey.
Passenger ids are stable for the whole booking. Counts change through add and remove, never by setting a count.
No component calculates a total. Feature containers read the state and pass plain props down to design-system components, which stay stateless.
Payment always sends quote.id; the server refuses an expired or mismatched quote.
Every quote request carries the page locale; the server returns lineItems[].label already translated.

domain.meaning: One origin → destination trip, as searched
One physical flight inside a journey
domain.example: DXB → JFK nonstop = 1 segment. A journey with a connection = 2 segments.
domain.owns: The seat map and the seat

stateModel.overview:
bookingState
  ├── search: { tripType, journeys[{ id, from, to, date }], cabin }
  ├── passengers: Passenger[]                   ← stable ids; types from the configured age bands
  ├── selections: Record<journeyId, { offerId, fareId, segmentIds[] } | null>
  ├── seats: Record<segmentId, Record<passengerId, seatId | null>>
  ├── payment: { currency, useMiles }
  └── quote: Quote | null                       ← from the server; never computed
stateModel.componentBoundaries:
[bookingState]  ⇄  [pricing API]
     ├── FlightResultCard / FareOptions (reads selections, dispatches SELECT_FARE)
     ├── PassengerSelector              (reads passengers, dispatches ADD/REMOVE_PASSENGER)
     ├── SeatMap                        (one per segment; reads seats[segmentId] + passengers, dispatches SELECT_SEAT)
     ├── BookingSummary                 (reads selections + quote; renders quote.lineItems)
     └── StickyCTABar                   (reads displayTotal + quoteStatus + canContinue)

actions.name: SET_SEARCH
actions.effect: Replaces search; clears selections, seats, quote

actions.name: ADD_PASSENGER / REMOVE_PASSENGER
actions.effect: Adds a passenger with a new id, or removes one by id. Other passengers keep their ids, so their seats stay attached. Removing a passenger removes their seats on every segment.

actions.name: SELECT_FARE
actions.effect: Sets selections[journeyId] (offer, fare, segments). Clears seats for the old segments of that journey only, because the flights or cabin may have changed.

actions.name: SELECT_SEAT
actions.effect: Sends the seat to the server first. On success, sets seats[segmentId][passengerId].

actions.name: SEAT_CONFLICT
actions.trigger: Server rejects SELECT_SEAT because the seat was just taken
actions.effect: Leaves seats unchanged (the passenger keeps any earlier seat). Marks the seat occupied in the cached seat map and refetches availability for that segment.

stateModel.requote: Set quoteStatus: 'pending', send the current selections to the pricing endpoint, and store the response. If a newer request is already in flight, ignore older responses (compare a request counter).

derived.from: passengersNeedingSeat − passengers with a seat on that segment
Step-specific completeness check (for example, every journey has a selection)
quote.total when quoteStatus is fresh; otherwise the previous total shown as updating

notDerivedOnClient: anything else with money in it

rules: Economy Flex includes free Regular seats.
Economy Flex Plus includes free Regular and Preferred seats.
Twin and Extra Legroom seats are always paid.
Business Special is free once check-in opens 48h before departure.
Skywards tier changes what is free.
Children get 50% off Regular and Preferred seats.

quoteLifecycle.ui: BookingSummary and StickyCTABar keep the previous total with a skeleton or "Updating…". The primary CTA waits.
expiresAt has passed. Re-quote before payment. If the price changed, show the old and new totals and ask the user to accept before paying.
Inline error with a retry button. The CTA stays disabled; the user's selections are kept.

implementationOptions.when: Most airline flows. The server stores the selections and the quote; the client mirrors them and refetches after each mutation.

implementationOptions.option: React Context + useReducer or Zustand as the client mirror
implementationOptions.when: Either works for the client copy of the selections. Zustand helps when state must survive route changes.

notThis: Not design-system state: Seat, Counter and PriceDisplay are stateless; the parent owns their values.
Not the Skywards account state (miles balance, tier).
Not the source of business rules or prices: fares, seat fees, age bands and their rules come from the API or config.

ambiguities.description: No pricing, seat-map or booking-session API contract (endpoints, request/response formats) is defined. Only client responsibilities and the Quote type are. This package does not invent one.
BookingState.quoteStatus includes 'idle'; the BookingSummary and StickyCTABar prop types list only pending | fresh | stale | error.
The state model names the fare component FareOptionsMatrix; inventory.md names it FareOptions (component id fare-options).
